name: symulate-k6-load-tests
description: k6 backend load testing suite for the Symulate AI platform — full flow: Super Admin login -> Create Client -> Create Activities (Role Play/Interview/Case/Situation/Board Meeting/Welcome) -> Assign to Org -> Client Admin (impersonated) Project + CSV candidate import -> Candidate login -> sequential activity completion. Supports with/without Talent Intelligence (Anum) and full/situation-only scenarios, plus live Grafana monitoring.

scripts.load:situation:no-anum: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only ANUM_API_ENABLED=false
scripts.load:all: npm run load && npm run load:no-anum && npm run load:situation && npm run load:situation:no-anum
scripts.load:grafana: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:grafana:no-anum: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load ANUM_API_ENABLED=false K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:grafana:situation: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
